caption: The drawing depicts the head and part of the neck of a lion-like creature, shown in profile facing to the left. The object appears to be a carved relief or possibly a fragment of a sculpture made of a wooden or stone material, illustrated in detailed grayscale with brownish and beige undertones. The lion's mouth is open, revealing its teeth and fangs, with a pronounced jawline, detailed nostrils, and a round, visible eye. The ear is closely set against the head, and the mane is represented by layered, curved shapes that flow backward from the head and neck. Several nails or rivets are visible on the surface, holding parts together or possibly remnants from affixing it to another structure. The background is a plain, untextured, off-white or cream color, which contrasts with the detailed rendering of the lion head structure.
title: Wolf's Head
